text:
alex: Heads-up: planning to cut py/ts patch tonight in the quiet window (22:00-23:30 UTC). Need pin strategy for publish, canary traffic shift plan, and explicit rollback criteria. @maria @sam can you confirm signer/checksum preflights?

maria: I can run wheel/tar checks and signer verif. Recommend dist-tag `canary` for 22:00, promote to `latest` after 30m of green smoke. Add a deprecation blurb for the old sync client in release notes.

sam: Agree on `canary` then promote. For rollback: if API error rate >1% or two customer-reported regressions within 15m, we rollback. Who runs rollback? ops or deploy-bot?

tyler: ops should execute rollback but deploy-bot has an automated rollback CLI. My vote: automated rollback if health checks hit threshold, otherwise ops manual if partial regressions.

jen: Docs + changelog: I'll draft deprecation note and add migration snippet for TS -> new client. Will push to `docs-release` branch before publish.

devex-bot: Change window reminder: no user-facing feature merges between 21:30-23:45 UTC. Releases may proceed with ops approval.

alex: Publishing commands (example):
```bash
# Python
python -m build && twine upload dist/* --sign
# Tagging
git tag -a v1.2.3 -m "release py 1.2.3" && git push origin v1.2.3
# NPM/TS
npm run build && npm publish --tag canary
# Promote after green: npm dist-tag add @our/sdk@2.0.1 latest && npm dist-tag rm @our/sdk canary
```

maria: Pre-publish checklist: verify GPG signatures on wheels, confirm package checksums match CI artifact store, verify PyPI owner list and npm org perms. I will run `twine check` and `gpg --verify` before upload.

sam: Pinning strategy: we'll pin the legacy sync client in our internal examples to `@our/sdk@~1.9.0` and add a notice to switch. For customers on older majors we won't yank versions, just add deprecation timeline in notes.

tyler: Canary traffic shift plan: 5% traffic for first 10m, 20% for next 10m, full at 30m if all checks pass. Health checks: 200 latency P95 within SLO and no increase in safety/semantics errors.

alex: Rollback command for deploy-bot (ops-run): `deploy-bot rollback --service sdks --to-tag previous --reason "regression"` — ops should be on-call during cut.

ci-bot: Preflight CI: unit tests ✅, integration smoke ✅, signed artifact hashes: OK, canary image pushed to registry `registry.redwood/devex/sdk:canary-3421009876`

jen: I'll land the release notes now and mark the changelog entry with the deprecation date (30 days notice). If we need to delay, call it out in this thread.

alex: Thanks — ops team please be ready at 21:50 UTC for the handoff. Will post a final readiness ping 10m before cut. :thumbsup:
